name: hermills
description: Hermills commercial desktop app for local agent deployment and custom agent building.
author: Hermills

scripts.dev: cross-env HERMILLS_DESKTOP_TOKEN=dev-token concurrently -k -n server,renderer,desktop "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:renderer" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5177 http://127.0.0.1:47321/api/health && cross-env HERMILLS_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5177 HERMILLS_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47321 npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:core && npm run build:agent-builder && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:server && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:zip: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac zip
scripts.build:dmg: npm run clean:release && npm run build && PATH=$PWD/scripts/bin:$PATH electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip
